summary:
Revised comprehensive plan combining the warm, handcrafted personal study journal visual redesign with smart, clutter-free decluttering.
Removes repetitive metrics, duplicate progress cards, and crowded header shortcut buttons while strictly protecting all essential features (FQT, Test 2, FE, Grade selection, Manual Subject editing, Study Targets, Pomodoro/Sprint Timers, 3D Bean world, Crops, Firebase sync, and practice tests). Incorporates Playfair Display serif headings, warm cream canvas, espresso typography, muted sage progress indicators, soft terracotta highlights, and paper textures.
